newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea denies talks of public service rate hike.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea denies talks of public service rate hike.

text.p: South Korea's Ministry of Finance and Economy on Friday denied local newspaper reports that it was planning to hike public service rates by the end of this year.
"The reports are completely wrong," said a senior official at the ministry.
The ministry said in a statement it has no plans to raise electricity rates, subway fares, highway tolls, prices of liquefied natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas.
Local newspapers said the ministry was considering raising those charges.
